name: Profab Metal Works, LLC. (Ironworks)
old_description: Founded by Jeremiah Barker and Lee Vickers, ProFab Metal Works, LLC is a welding and fabrication shop based out of Athens, AL. We provide custom welding and fabrication services to customers in the Athens, Madison, and Huntsville, AL area. Our mission is to provide high quality, custom fabrication, along with welding repairs at a fair price!
about:
Profab Metal Works, LLC operates as a welding and fabrication shop in Athens, Alabama. The company was founded by Jeremiah Barker and Lee Vickers to provide custom welding and fabrication services to the Athens, Madison, and Huntsville areas.

The shop delivers custom welding and fabrication for residential and commercial clients, producing gates, fences, handrails, and custom mailboxes as an Imperial Mailbox dealer. It also handles welding repairs and miscellaneous projects such as fowl racks and the Merchant's Alley sign for the Athens Mainstreet Beautification project. Processes cover welding and fabrication in mild steel, aluminum, and stainless steel.

Customers span residential, commercial, construction, industrial, and municipal sectors. Homeowners and businesses in the Athens–Huntsville corridor request gates, fences, and railings; contractors and industrial firms rely on the shop for structural welding; the city of Athens commissioned a decorative sign for its downtown beautification effort.

The founders emphasize high-quality custom fabrication and fair‑priced welding repairs. Barker brings over 17 years of experience across residential, commercial, construction, and industrial welding, plus teaching credentials from Drake State Technical College and Calhoun Community College. Vickers, a former NFL player and local business owner, adds entrepreneurial leadership through his landscaping firm.

name: Profile Plastics LLC
old_description: Profile Plastics specializes in several advanced molding techniques that combine decoration and electronics with injection molding:
about:
Profile Plastics operates a manufacturing plant in Chanhassen, Minnesota, where it produces custom thermoplastic injection-molded parts. The company was established as a United States plastic parts manufacturer, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Its core capabilities center on advanced molding techniques that combine decoration and electronics with injection molding. These include In-Mold Decorating (IMD), In-Mold Labeling (IML) also known as Film Insert Molding (FIM), In-Mold Electronics (IME), and Injection Molded Structural Electronics (IMSE), all delivered with precision registered graphics. The firm also provides integrated engineering, development, and molding services under one roof and employs cell manufacturing to reduce costs, accelerate turnaround, and improve quality.

Profile Plastics serves the automotive, medical, and appliance sectors, supplying OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers with decorated and electronically functional plastic components. Examples include driver-interface parts for vehicles, healthcare device housings, and intuitive control panels for appliances.

The company emphasizes a hybrid model: the focus and expertise of a small company paired with the resources and purchasing power of a large corporation. It highlights its IMSE technology as a next-generation method that fuses human-machine interfaces, enabling customers to respond to unanticipated demand and elevate part functionality.

name: Progressive Plastics Inc
old_description: Progressive Plastics, Inc. was founded in 1986 by Keith Brackett, who originally saw the need for a short run molder processing small quantities for both individuals and businesses. Further alo...
about:
Progressive Plastics, Inc. operates from Clover, South Carolina, a location centrally positioned between Charlotte, North Carolina, and Greenville, South Carolina with easy access to major highways and an international airport. The company was founded in 1986 by Keith Brackett, who identified a market need for a short-run molder capable of processing small quantities for both individuals and businesses. That focus later expanded to include insert molding, a process Brackett recognized as too labor-intensive for larger molders.

Today, Progressive Plastics functions as a small custom injection molder of thermoplastic products. Its core capability is plastic injection molding, including insert molding that encapsulates metal or other non-plastic inserts in a single operation. The company also provides development design and consultation services to guide customers through the product creation process. Its product line centers on agricultural packaging, notably a range of fruit baskets — round half-gallon, half-bushel, peck, and rectangular half-gallon containers — designed to protect produce such as peaches, berries, apples, and tomatoes from field to packing shed.

The primary market served is agriculture, where growers, distributors, and packers rely on the company's durable thermoplastic containers. Because the operation is geared toward short runs, it also accommodates individual entrepreneurs and small businesses needing limited quantities. The company states its goal is total customer satisfaction through defect-free processes and continuous improvement, with the owner directly accessible for questions and order assistance.

Brackett started the business after seeing that larger molders avoided short-run and labor-intensive insert molding work. That founding principle remains: the firm positions itself on personable, knowledgeable service, on-time delivery, and a willingness to handle orders that larger competitors decline.

name: Promarksvac Corp. - Industrial Food Vacuum Packaging Machine & Commercial Meat Processing Equipment
old_description: Manufacturer of Vacuum Packaging Machine for the Food & Non-Food Industry
about:
Promarksvac Corp. was founded in 1989 in Ontario, California, as a California corporation. The company operates as the parent of Foodmax, Profood, and the Promarks Heat Seal Division, with manufacturing facilities in the United States and Taiwan. The U.S. headquarters handles sales and distribution for North and South America, while the Taiwan facility serves the Pacific Rim and other international markets.

The company manufactures a range of vacuum packaging machines, including tabletop, single-chamber, double-chamber, belt-type, and nozzle-type models, as well as rollstock and MAP tray sealing systems. Its food processing equipment line covers brine injectors, vacuum tumblers and massagers, shrink tanks, mixers, and hydraulic piston stuffers. Promarksvac also builds custom machinery, such as high-vacuum laminating systems and 300-inch heat sealers, and integrates PLC/HMI controls and temperature-controlled sealing on many models. Selected systems use Busch vacuum pumps and carry UL, ETL, or NSF certifications.

Promarksvac serves the food industry — meat, poultry, seafood, cheese, and ready-to-eat meals — as well as non-food and medical packaging applications. Customers range from butcher shops, delis, and restaurants to large-scale production plants. The equipment is designed for both small production spaces and high-volume lines.

The company emphasizes innovation, durable construction, and long-term technical support. Its stated mission is to provide competitively priced packaging and processing solutions with ongoing equipment innovation and customer satisfaction, aiming to enhance productivity and profitability for its partners.

name: Propper Manufacturing Company Inc
old_description: Propper Manufacturing Company is excited to announce that EO Chex™ Ethylene Oxide (EO) Indicator Tape has achieved FDA clearance, solidifying its position as the only FDA-cleared EO indicator tape on the market.
about:
Propper Manufacturing Company, Inc. operates from Long Island City, New York. Founded in 1945, the family-owned business has remained under family stewardship for nearly eight decades. The company was established to address sterilization monitoring needs in healthcare settings.

The company manufactures disposable medical devices with a focus on sterilization monitoring. Its product line includes chemical indicators (Type 1 and Type 5), biological indicators (Duo-Spore®), Bowie-Dick test packs, EO sterilization monitoring tools (including the FDA-cleared EO Chex™ indicator tape), and reusable process challenge devices (Vapor Line® Helix-Type PCD). They also produce Magnalume™ disposable laryngoscope blades made from high-strength polycarbonate, microscope slides, cover glass, hemacytometers, surgical blades, and other laboratory and surgical instruments. The facility offers private labeling and OEM manufacturing services, and runs a Culture Service Program for biological monitoring.

Propper serves hospitals, laboratories, veterinary clinics, dental offices, biotech and pharmaceutical companies, scientific research institutions, and body modification professionals. The company also supports international markets and provides OEM solutions for major healthcare brands.

The company states its mission is to provide high-quality infection control products that aid in eliminating hospital-acquired infections. It emphasizes investment in groundbreaking products and customer education through platforms like Propper Connects.

name: Proto Part Inc.
old_description: All tooling is created in-house, & we can run plastic parts from hundreds to hundreds of thousands.
about:
Proto Part Inc. operates from Hudson, New Hampshire, where it has been producing thermoplastic injection molded parts for over 25 years. The company emphasizes American manufacturing and win-win relationships, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The shop specializes in thermoplastic injection molding with all tooling built in-house. Capabilities include insert molding, family molding, and design-for-manufacturability support, running on horizontal and vertical presses ranging from 28 to 310 clamping tons with shot sizes of 1 to 25 ounces. Processes follow scientific injection molding and decoupled molding principles, with ongoing automation investments to increase efficiency. Production volumes span from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of parts per run, covering both mid- and high-volume orders.

Proto Part serves medical, defense, safety, electronic/electrical, industrial, aerospace, solar, and automotive markets, as well as niche consumer products such as cribbage pegs, golf tees, tape containers, and archery bowstring spools. Long-term customers include Semiconductor Circuits Inc., Road Tools LLC, Mirror Tee, RF Hunter, and Wall Industries, with relationships exceeding 20 years in some cases.

The company cites complete customer satisfaction as its founding principle, differentiating itself through in-house tooling, ISO 9001:2015 certification, and a commitment to better communication and total transparency. Engineers assist with part design to meet structural requirements, and the firm promotes creative, economical, and quick solutions for custom plastic components.

name: Provideon Wire & Cable
old_description: was founded in 2022 under the leadership and expertise of our founder and president, who has over 30 years of experience in the low voltage wire and cable industry.
about:
Provideon Wire & Cable was founded in 2022 in Washington, Pennsylvania, by the former president of a third-generation Western Pennsylvania wire company. The founder drew on 30 years of industry experience and a family legacy passed down from his father and grandfathers to establish the business on principles of quality and service.

The company manufactures and distributes a range of low-voltage wire and cable products, including audio/video, life safety, networking, communications, and control cables. Product lines span Pro-Comm A/V, Life Safety Systems, Networking Cable, LV Communication + Control, Water Otter Cable, and cable accessories. The team brings over 350 years of combined experience in design, engineering, manufacturing, and sales, averaging 20 years per employee, and holds several U.S. patents and trademarks.

Provideon serves K-12 schools, colleges, houses of worship, commercial buildings, performing arts centers, stadiums, arenas, and factory floors—anywhere low-voltage communication and control cable is required. A network of internal and external sales representatives supports customers across these verticals.

Pulse Turnkey, based in Fort Worth, Texas, was founded in 2020 by James Lockhart. Lockhart, a former top-performing solar salesman, launched the company with three team members after earning national sales recognition four years running.

The firm operates as a vertically integrated electrical contractor and EPC provider, delivering solar photovoltaic installations, battery backup systems, generator backup power, and roofing services across Texas, Oklahoma, Colorado, Utah, and Louisiana. With in-house crews and proprietary project-management software, Pulse Turnkey handles engineering, permitting, procurement, installation, and commissioning. The company reports more than 100 active projects and annual revenue exceeding $33 million.

Customers range from homeowners to commercial, industrial, and government clients, including schools and developers. The company's solar work spans residential rooftops to large-scale commercial arrays, while its roofing division installs asphalt shingles, metal, TPO, and flat-roof systems. Generator and battery solutions are tailored for critical-load backup and whole-facility resilience.

Lockhart has emphasized a debt-free balance sheet and a culture built on family and long-time associates. Pulse Turnkey was named a Top Solar Installer by Forbes, and its crews hold NABCEP certification. The company markets itself as a one-stop shop for multi-trade construction, differentiating through end-to-end control and transparent project tracking.
